title: Ninja Dual Zone £119.99, Dyson V15 £449 and Nespresso Vertuo Pop £49
description: Monday's UK deals: Ninja AF300UK below last Black Friday's price, Dyson V15 Detect at £449, Nespresso Vertuo Pop £49, plus Airwrap and gift sets.
intro:
**Monday's best deal is the Ninja Foodi Dual Zone AF300UK at £119.99 on Amazon, already below what it cost last Black Friday.** AO has cut the Dyson V15 Detect Absolute to £449 (£426 for AO members), the cheapest we can find, and John Lewis has the Nespresso Vertuo Pop at £49 and the Dyson Airwrap i.d. at £379. Amazon's device deals on Kindle, Echo and Fire TV are due to start today, and John Lewis's main Black Friday event starts tomorrow.

Every price below was checked on 16 November. Buy now or wait? The air fryers, V15 and Vertuo Pop are at or near their lows, so they're safe buys. The Airwrap and Shark FlexStyle are good prices but have been a little cheaper before.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi Dual Zone Air Fryer 7.6L (AF300UK)
deals.note: The two-drawer air fryer to buy if you're feeding a family. It was £129 here on Saturday and £128 last Black Friday, so there's no point waiting. Our new [Black Friday kitchen deals spotlight](/spotlight/black-friday-kitchen-deals-2026/) has more.

deals.name: Dyson V15 Detect Absolute Cordless Vacuum, Yellow/Nickel
deals.note: Dyson's most powerful V15, with the light that shows dust on hard floors and a particle counter. Argos and John Lewis are £479.99; AO is £30 cheaper, or £426 for AO members. See our new [Dyson V15 deals guide](/guides/dyson-v15-deals-uk/).

deals.name: Tower Vortx Vizion 11L Dual Basket Air Fryer (T17102)
deals.note: A cheaper way to get two big baskets, with windows so you can check the food. £79 is the lowest PriceSpy and Which? have recorded, so this is about as low as it goes.

deals.name: Nespresso Vertuo Pop by De'Longhi (ENV90)
deals.note: A compact pod machine and an easy present. Prices run from £49 to £54 by colour; £49 matches its all-time low.

deals.name: De'Longhi Magnifica Evo Bean-to-Cup Coffee Machine (ECAM290.22.B)
deals.note: Fresh-ground coffee with a milk frother and no pods to keep buying. Most other shops on PriceSpy want £500-plus for this exact model.

deals.name: Dyson Airwrap i.d. Straight+Wavy, Ceramic Pink
deals.note: The app-connected Airwrap for straight or wavy hair. It's £20 under Dyson's own Black Friday price, though it did hit about £372 last year. Cheaper options are in our [Dyson Airwrap guide](/guides/dyson-airwrap-deals-uk/).

deals.name: Shark FlexStyle 5-in-1 Air Styler and Hair Dryer with Storage Case (HD446SLUK), Stone
deals.note: The best-known Airwrap alternative, with the full set of attachments and a case. Shark has the black version at the same price. It's about £35 below the 2024 Black Friday price.

deals.name: Estée Lauder Glimmer The Perfect Duo Holiday Fragrance Gift Set
deals.note: A boxed fragrance gift for Christmas, 30% off as part of John Lewis's early beauty offers. More options in our [perfume gift sets guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/).

deals.name: Dunelm 2 Tier Heated Airer
deals.note: Dries washing indoors for a few pence an hour. It's Dunelm's own brand, so we can't compare it elsewhere; treat it as half the usual price rather than a record. See our [heated airer guide](/guides/heated-clothes-airer-deals-uk/).

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Amazon's Black Friday Week starts on Thursday 19 November, and device deals on Kindle, Echo, Fire TV and Ring are due from today. Last year the Echo Dot fell to about £30 and the Fire TV Stick 4K to about £25, so use those as your targets. Our refreshed [Amazon Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) has the rest, and our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) now includes John Lewis (main event from 17 November), Debenhams and Lidl.

Hold off on KitchenAid mixers, Sage espresso machines and Smeg kettles: all are still above their recent lows.

## This week: Black Friday kitchen deals

Air fryers, Ninja gadgets and pod coffee machines are already at their lowest prices, while some premium brands are still to drop. Our [Black Friday kitchen deals 2026 spotlight](/spotlight/black-friday-kitchen-deals-2026/) shows what to buy now, what to wait for and the prices worth paying.
